assessment: This fundamental study represents a real tour de force, demonstrating the impact of mutation on the mRNA decapping machinery. Accumulation of mRNAs in dcp2 mutants, is dependent both on the classical 5' to 3' pathway of mRNA decay and on the NMD pathway- highlighting the 'non-nonsense' roles of the NMD pathway and how little we really know about the complete set of pathways of mRNA degradation.
